1.consolidated_definition: Machete, perrillo. “En una lista de efectos introducidos por los extranjeros en P. R. aparecen: machetes con hojas de sol y luna.” O’Reilly, . “De las clases altas bajó el merengue hasta los bailes de garabato, donde, por cierto, hubo más de una pendencia en que salió de la vaina el sol y luna.” José P. Morales Miranda, , p. 56.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Machete, perrillo. "In a list of effects introduced by foreigners in P.R., machetes with sun and moon blades are mentioned." O'Reilly, . "From the upper classes, merengue descended to garabato dances, where, incidentally, there were more than one altercation in which the sun and moon came out of their sheaths." José P. Morales Miranda, , p. 56.

Traducción:

Machete, perrillo: A type of machete with a distinctive blade shape, often associated with traditional Puerto Rican culture.
P.R.: Abbreviation for Puerto Rico.
Garabato dances: Traditional folk dances in Puerto Rico characterized by intricate footwork and rhythmic movements.
Merengue: A popular dance style originating from the Dominican Republic but widely adopted in Puerto Rico.
Sheaths: Protective covers for swords or blades.
